name: Mirage
classType: Transcendent grade Counter-Terrorist character (Buff class, 2021 Season 2)

profile.occupation: Leading virtual streamer on the VR platform Krono World; secretly an excellent hacker

tagline: Krono World's star VR streamer with a hacker's secret - and a suspicious log she can't ignore.
summary: Mirage is a Transcendent grade Counter-Terrorist character released alongside her twin sister Anemone on 1 July 2021 (Korea). A top virtual streamer on the VR platform Krono World, she is in fact a skilled hacker who is lively online but shy and timid offline. After stumbling upon a suspicious Krono World log she attempts to contact the Aegis Lab while enemies close in for the information.
story:
Although Mirage is a leading virtual streamer on the VR platform Krono World, she is actually an excellent hacker. She has a lively personality online but is shy and timid offline.

She discovers a suspicious log of Krono World that she stumbled upon, and tries to contact the Aegis Lab to avoid the enemies approaching for the information. Her twin sister Anemone, a Krono World pro gamer, accompanies her as a guardian.
personality: Lively online persona, but shy and timid offline. Highly intelligent (skilled hacker).

quotes.context: Page header quote (game start voice line)

quotes.text: If you want to request a mission, now's the time!

abilities.name: Defense Code (Exclusive Skill)
abilities.description: Activates a ranged (area) skill that protects the user and allies for a certain period of time when used in Zombie Scenario.

abilities.name: Extra Satellite Mine
abilities.description: Receive +1 more Satellite Mine to use when playing as Mirage.

abilities.name: Higher Zombie Scenario level
abilities.description: Higher level than the normal class in Zombie Scenario Mode.

abilities.name: Zombie Z mutation
abilities.description: One initial mutation is added in Zombie Z mode.

abilities.name: Damage HUD and dedicated kill mark
abilities.description: Current damage is displayed on the lower HUD; a dedicated kill mark is shown on kills.

relatedCharacters: Aegis Institute (Aegis Lab) - she tries to contact them
trivia: Her face is similar to Miho and her hairstyle is similar to Yuri and Michaela.
She highly resembles Hatsune Miku, a Vocaloid voicebank developed by Crypton Future Media.
The background image on her page shows Mirage in Panic Room.
Not to be confused with the map of the same name (Mirage (Map)).
